disagreements.topic: Split-off share retirement and EPS dilution (8-9M shares, ~$0.5)
disagreements.resolution: Settled at ~8.5M shares retired (range 7.5-9.5M) and ~$0.5 of 2027 EPS dilution (range $0.45-0.55, ~3.1%). Eaton holders get >=50.1% of a combined company with >$10B EV. The $5.1B Mobility value less the $1.1B cash funded by SpinCo debt implies ~$3.5-4.0B of equity to Eaton holders. At a typical 7-10% exchange-offer discount and ~$432, that retires 7.5-9M shares. Mobility segment profit is $109M in Q2 and $198M in H1, ~$400-440M/yr pre-tax, or ~$330-360M after tax. That is ~5.5-5.9% of ~$6.1B 2027 net income, offset by ~$40M of after-tax interest saved (0.65%) and ~2.2% fewer shares, for a net ~-3.1%. Each 1M shares is ~$0.04 EPS, ~$1/share of value. So the 8-vs-9M dispute is immaterial and the spread in agents' fair values does not come from here. The residual risk is stranded corporate cost (~$0.05). The share count also depends on ETN's price at the offer: a higher price retires fewer shares, at the same value.
disagreements.evidence: Eaton Ex.99.1 (Jun 11, 2026): Mobility ~$5.1B, 8.3x 2026E EBITDA; combined EV >$10B; $1.1B cash to Eaton, used 'including repayment of outstanding indebtedness'; Eaton holders >=50.1%. Q2 2026 release: Mobility sales $841M and operating profit $109M (H1 $1,607M / $198M). Q2 10-Q: exchange offer (split-off) with a clean-up pro-rata distribution only if needed; a spin-off if the deal fails.

disagreements.topic: How much of the rate move belongs in the multiple
disagreements.positions: agent_1: 26x to 25.5x and FCF yield +10bp for the 10-year at 5.24%. agent_3: holds 25x, citing rates. agent_4: 26x to 25.5x. agent_2: peer leg 28x to 27x. agent_5: 26x, no extra cut. My round 1: 26x, with rates as a reason against re-rating and for fat tails.
disagreements.resolution: Little to none of it belongs in the median multiple. The 10-year rose 49bp in September, from 4.75% on Aug 31 to 5.24% on Sep 28, while ETN rose from $401.88 to $433.27 (Sep 29). So the current ~28.5x NTM (~29x on core ex-Mobility) is already set against a 5.24% 10-year and a hiking Fed, and the October hike odds (~67%, Polymarket per agent_5) are largely priced too. The compression from ~28.5x today to ~26x at the horizon is justified by growth decelerating (NTM EPS growth ~16-17% now vs ~13% in a year). Stacking a further 0.5-1 turn for the rate level already in the price double-counts, ~$8/share (~2%) for agents 1, 3 and 4. Only unexpected further rate rises belong in the forecast, and they are two-sided, so they go in the width and left tail (which all agents already fattened), not the median. I keep 26x.
disagreements.evidence: FRED DGS10 daily (Aug 31 4.75%; Sep 15 5.00%; Sep 23 5.11%; Sep 28 5.24%). ETN daily closes (Twelve Data): Aug 31 $401.88, Sep 15 $392.40, Sep 29 $433.27. Fed funds upper bound 4.00% from Sep 17 (FRED DFEDTARU, verified in round 1).

EDGAR shows no 8-K since Jul 31 (only Forms 3/4/144). Eaton usually announces the date about a week ahead (the Jan 26, 2026 release announced Feb 3). Recent report days mix first-week Tuesdays (Nov 4 2025, Feb 3 and May 5 2026) with month-end days (Oct 31 2024, Jan 31 2025, Jul 31 2026, a Friday). Management guided to the high end at Laguna, so an in-window print leans slightly positive but mainly adds variance. The 1-month ladder stays at the mean.
